title: Add trace and usage SQLAlchemy models to chatbot/db/models.py
description:
Extend chatbot/db/models.py with observability-related SQLAlchemy model classes: TraceRecord and UsageRecord. These tables provide optional persistent storage for traces and usage metrics if the operator chooses a database-backed store instead of the default in-memory collector.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- chatbot/db/models.py (existing SQLAlchemy models — understand base class, column conventions, import style, primary key pattern, and table naming conventions)
- chatbot/observability/tracing.py (created by task t.1 — understand TraceRecord field shapes)
- chatbot/observability/metrics.py (created by task t.2 — understand ModelMetrics, SessionMetrics, TokenUsage field shapes)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/db/models.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open chatbot/db/models.py and inspect the existing SQLAlchemy model classes. Understand:
   - The base class used (e.g. Base = declarative_base())
   - The import style for SQLAlchemy
   - The primary key and id column convention
   - Column naming (snake_case)
   - How JSON/dict columns are stored (JSON, PickleType, or Text)

2. Add a `TraceRecord` model class with __tablename__ = 'observability_traces':
   - id: Column matching the project's id convention (primary key)
   - trace_id: Column(String(36), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True) — uuid4 string
   - turn_id: Column(String(36), nullable=False, index=True)
   - session_id: Column(String(36), nullable=False, index=True)
   - user_id: Column(String(36), nullable=True, index=True)
   - model_provider: Column(String(64), nullable=True)
   - model_id: Column(String(128), nullable=True)
   - task_class: Column(String(32), nullable=True)
   - prompt_tokens: Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
   - completion_tokens: Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
   - cost_usd_micros: Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
   - total_latency_ms: Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0)
   - retrieve_latency_ms: Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0)
   - prompt: Column(Text, nullable=False, default='')
   - routing_decision: Column(JSON, nullable=False, default_factory=dict)
   - retrieval_snippets: Column(JSON, nullable=False, default_factory=list)
   - steps: Column(JSON, nullable=False, default_factory=list)
   - created_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=func.now())

3. Add a `UsageRecord` model class with __tablename__ = 'observability_usage':
   - id: Column matching the project's id convention (primary key)
   - session_id: Column(String(36), nullable=False, index=True)
   - model_provider: Column(String(64), nullable=False, index=True)
   - model_id: Column(String(128), nullable=False, index=True)
   - turn_count: Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
   - prompt_tokens: Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
   - completion_tokens: Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
   - cost_usd_micros: Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
   - avg_latency_ms: Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0)
   - created_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=func.now())
   - updated_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now())
   - A unique constraint on (session_id, model_provider, model_id).

4. Existing model classes and columns must be completely unchanged.
